tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. Probes Slack OAuth credentials and API reachability via auth.test.

tools.name: list-channels
tools.description: List channels. Returns curated rows { id, name, isPrivate, isArchived, isMember, numMembers, topic, purpose, created } + nextCursor. Params: types? (CSV public_channel|private_channel|mpim|im), limit (1-1000, def 100), cursor, excludeArchived (def true), fields?, includeRaw.

types.description: Comma-separated channel types from public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im. Default: public_channel,private_channel.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 1000, default 100.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack channel objects. Default false.

tools.name: get-channel
tools.description: Get a single channel. Returns { id, name, isPrivate, isArchived, isMember, numMembers, topic, purpose, created, creator, isGeneral, isShared } + extras. Params: channelId, fields?, includeRaw.

channelId.description: Slack channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...).

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack channel object. Default false.

tools.name: create-channel
tools.description: Create a channel. Slack normalizes the name (lowercase, no spaces, only [a-z0-9_-], ≤80). Returns the curated channel + ActionBadge('created'). Not retryable. Params: name, isPrivate? (def false), topic?, fields?, includeRaw.

topic.description: Optional channel topic, set after creation.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned channel.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack channel object. Default false.

tools.name: archive-channel
tools.description: Archive a channel (read-only afterwards). Returns { id, name } from a follow-up info call. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

tools.name: join-channel
tools.description: Join a public channel. Returns the curated channel. Idempotent (already_in_channel raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channelId.

tools.name: invite-to-channel
tools.description: Invite users to a channel. Returns { channel, invitedUserIds, alreadyInChannel? }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, userIds[].

userIds.description: Slack user ids (U... / W...) to invite.

tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Post a message to a channel, DM, or as a top-level message. Returns { ts, channel, message, permalink }. Not retryable (no idempotency key — duplicate messages on retry). Params: channel, text, blocks? (JSON), threadTs?, unfurlLinks (def true), unfurlMedia (def true).

channel.description: Channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...) or user id (U... for DM).

text.description: Plain text body. Required even when blocks are provided (used as fallback).

blocks.description: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string (will be parsed).

threadTs.description: Parent message ts to post as a thread reply. Use send-thread-reply for the canonical thread API.

unfurlLinks.description: Unfurl links in the message. Default true.

unfurlMedia.description: Unfurl media in the message. Default true.

tools.name: send-thread-reply
tools.description: Reply inside a Slack thread. Returns { ts, channel, threadTs, broadcast, message }. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: channel, threadTs, text, blocks? (JSON), broadcast (def false).

channel.description: Channel id where the parent message lives.

blocks.description: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string.

broadcast.description: Also broadcast the reply to the channel. Default false.

tools.name: list-messages
tools.description: List messages from a channel or thread (passes threadTs to fetch replies). Returns curated rows { ts, channel, user, text, threadTs, replyCount, reactions, permalink, createdAt } + nextCursor + isThread. Params: channel, threadTs?, limit (1-200, def 50), cursor, oldest, latest, inclusive, fields?, includeRaw.

channel.description: Slack channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...).

threadTs.description: Parent message ts to fetch thread replies. Format 1234567890.123456.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack message objects. Default false.

tools.name: add-reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, name }. Idempotent (already_reacted raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channel, timestamp, name (no colons).

channel.description: Channel id where the message is.

tools.name: remove-reaction
tools.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, name }. Idempotent (no_reaction raises BUSINESS_RULE). Params: channel, timestamp, name (no colons).

channel.description: Channel id where the message is.

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: List workspace users. Returns curated rows { id, name, realName, displayName, email, imageUrl, isBot, isAdmin, isOwner, deleted, tz } + nextCursor. Params: limit (1-200, def 100), cursor, includeDeleted (def false), includeBots (def true), fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 100.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack user objects. Default false.

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Get a single user by id or email. Returns the curated user (id, name, realName, displayName, email, imageUrl, profile, tz). Provide exactly one of userId/email. Params: userId?, email?, fields?, includeRaw.

userId.description: Slack user id (U... / W...). Mutex with email.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack user object. Default false.

tools.name: get-user-presence
tools.description: Get presence for a Slack user. Returns { user, presence, online, autoAway, manualAway, connectionCount, lastActivity }. Params: userId.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a local file to Slack and optionally share it. Returns the curated file (id, name, mimetype, size, permalink, thumbUrl). Path must resolve to an absolute path. Not retryable. Params: filePath, channels?[], title?, initialComment?, threadTs?, fields?, includeRaw.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file (≤100 MB).

channels.description: Slack channel ids to share to. Single id is fine.

initialComment.description: Optional comment posted alongside the file.

threadTs.description: Optional parent message ts to share inside a thread.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned file.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack file object. Default false.

tools.name: list-files
tools.description: List uploaded files. Returns curated rows { id, name, title, mimetype, prettyType, size, user, urlPrivate, permalink, thumbUrl, createdAt } + paging. Params: channel?, user?, limit (1-100, def 20), page (def 1), tsFrom, tsTo, types? (CSV all|spaces|snippets|images|gdocs|zips|pdfs), fields?, includeRaw.

channel.description: Filter by channel id.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.

tsFrom.description: Filter files created after this Unix timestamp.

tsTo.description: Filter files created before this Unix timestamp.

types.description: Comma-separated types from all, spaces, snippets, images, gdocs, zips, pdfs. Default all.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack file objects. Default false.

tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search messages workspace-wide. Supports Slack search syntax (in:#channel, from:@user, before/after). Returns curated hits { ts, channel, channelName, user, userName, text, permalink, score } + total + page. Params: query, sort? (score|timestamp), sortDirection? (asc|desc), count (1-100, def 20), page, highlight, fields?, includeRaw.

query.description: Slack search query (supports operators like in:#channel, from:@user).

sort.description: Sort by relevance or time. Default score.

count.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.

highlight.description: Highlight matching terms in returned text. Default false.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack search.matches[]. Default false.

tools.name: search-files
tools.description: Search files workspace-wide. Supports Slack search syntax (in:#channel, from:@user, type:pdf). Returns curated hits { id, name, title, mimetype, permalink, thumbUrl, score, createdAt } + total + page. Params: query, sort? (score|timestamp), sortDirection?, count (1-100, def 20), page, highlight, fields?, includeRaw.

query.description: Slack search query (supports operators like type:pdf, in:#channel).

sort.description: Sort by relevance or time. Default score.

count.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 20.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack search.files.matches[]. Default false.

tools.name: get-team-info
tools.description: Get the connected Slack workspace info. Returns { id, name, domain, emailDomain, iconUrl, enterpriseId, enterpriseName }. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned team.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack team object. Default false.

tools.name: update-message
tools.description: Edit an existing message. The token user must be the author. Returns { ts, channel, text, message }. Not retryable. Params: channel, ts, text? or blocks? (at least one required), attachments? (JSON).

channel.description: Channel id where the message lives (C... / G... / D... / M...).

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to edit ("1234567890.123456").

text.description: New plain text body. At least one of text/blocks must be provided.

blocks.description: New Slack Block Kit JSON string (will be parsed). Replaces existing blocks.

attachments.description: New attachments JSON string (legacy). Pass [] to clear.

tools.name: delete-message
tools.description: Delete a message. The token user must be author or workspace admin. Returns { channel, ts, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, ts, asUser? (default true).

channel.description: Channel id where the message lives.

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to delete.

asUser.description: Delete as the authenticated user (default true). Set false only if the token has admin scope.

tools.name: get-permalink
tools.description: Get a permanent URL for a message. Returns { channel, ts, permalink }. Idempotent, retryable. Params: channel, ts.

channel.description: Channel id.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: schedule-message
tools.description: Schedule a message to be posted at a future unix-seconds timestamp. Returns { channel, scheduledMessageId, postAt }. Slack rejects postAt > 120 days ahead. Not retryable. Params: channel, text, postAt (unix seconds), blocks?, threadTs?, unfurlLinks (def true), unfurlMedia (def true).

channel.description: Channel id or user id (DM).

postAt.description: Unix seconds when the message should post. Must be future and ≤120 days ahead.

blocks.description: Optional Slack Block Kit JSON string.

threadTs.description: Parent message ts for thread reply.

tools.name: list-scheduled-messages
tools.description: List pending scheduled messages for the authenticated user. Returns { messages: [{ id, channelId, postAt, postAtIso, text }], nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: channel?, latest?, oldest? (unix-seconds bounds), limit (1-100, def 100), cursor?.

channel.description: Filter to a single channel id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: delete-scheduled-message
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled message. Returns { channel, scheduledMessageId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, scheduledMessageId, asUser? (def true).

channel.description: Channel id where the message was scheduled.

asUser.description: Delete as the authenticated user (default true).

tools.name: send-ephemeral
tools.description: Post an ephemeral message visible only to one user in a channel. Returns { channel, user, messageTs }. Not retryable. Params: channel, user (recipient), text, blocks?, threadTs?.

channel.description: Channel id.

user.description: User id of the recipient (U... / W...). Only they will see it.

threadTs.description: Parent message ts for ephemeral thread reply.

tools.name: pin-message
tools.description: Pin a message to a channel. Returns { channel, timestamp, pinned: true }. Idempotent (already_pinned not treated as error). Params: channel, timestamp.

channel.description: Channel id (C... / G... / D... / M...).

tools.name: unpin-message
tools.description: Unpin a message. Returns { channel, timestamp, unpinned: true }. Idempotent (no_pin not treated as error). Params: channel, timestamp.

channel.description: Channel id.

tools.name: list-pins
tools.description: List items pinned to a channel (messages and files). Returns { pins: [{ type, createdAt, createdBy, message? | file? }], count }. Retryable. Params: channel.

channel.description: Channel id whose pins to list.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: add-bookmark
tools.description: Add a bookmark to a channel (links shown in the channel header). Returns the curated bookmark. Not retryable. Params: channel, title, link (URL), emoji? (e.g. ':notebook:').

channel.description: Channel id.

link.description: URL the bookmark points to (http/https only).

emoji.description: Optional emoji shortcode for the bookmark icon.

tools.name: remove-bookmark
tools.description: Remove a channel bookmark by id. Returns { channel, bookmarkId, removed: true }. Not retryable. Params: channel, bookmarkId.

channel.description: Channel id.

tools.name: list-bookmarks
tools.description: List bookmarks attached to a channel. Returns { bookmarks: [{ id, channelId, title, link, emoji, type, dateCreated, dateUpdated, rank }], count }. Retryable. Params: channel.

channel.description: Channel id.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-file
tools.description: Get full info for a file (channels shared, permalinks, optional comments). Returns curated file + comments?[]. Retryable. Params: fileId (F...), includeComments (def false), includeRaw.

includeComments.description: Include comment list (legacy API). Default false.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack file object. Default false.

tools.name: delete-file
tools.description: Delete a file. The token user must be owner or workspace admin. Returns { fileId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. Params: fileId (F...).

tools.name: leave-channel
tools.description: Leave a public or private channel. Returns { channelId, notInChannel }. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

tools.name: list-channel-members
tools.description: List user ids that are members of a channel. Returns { channelId, members: string[], nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Use list-users + lookup if you need profile info. Params: channelId, limit (1-1000, def 200), cursor?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: open-dm
tools.description: Open or fetch a direct conversation. Single user → IM (D...); multiple → MPIM (M...). Idempotent (re-opens existing channel). Returns curated channel. Params: users[] (1+ U.../W... ids), returnIm (def true).

users.description: Array of Slack user ids. 1 user → IM. 2-8 users → MPIM.

tools.name: get-user-profile
tools.description: Get the full Slack profile for a user (status, custom_fields, image, phone, title, timezone). Returns curated profile. Retryable. Params: userId? (default: authed user), includeLabels (def false), includeRaw.

userId.description: User id (U... / W...). Omit to get the authenticated user's own profile.

includeLabels.description: Include custom field labels in the response. Default false.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Slack profile object. Default false.

tools.name: update-user-profile
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's Slack profile (status, name fields, phone, title, custom fields). Returns the updated profile object. Not retryable. Params: statusText?, statusEmoji?, statusExpiration? (unix seconds), realName?, displayName?, phone?, title?, customFields? (JSON map of field_id → {value, alt?}), userId? (admin-only).

statusText.description: Short status (≤100 chars). Pass empty string to clear.

statusEmoji.description: Emoji shortcode for status. Pass empty to clear.

statusExpiration.description: Unix seconds when the status auto-clears. 0 = never expire.

customFields.description: JSON string mapping custom field ids to {value, alt?}.

userId.description: Admin-only: target another user's profile (requires admin scope).

tools.name: set-dnd
tools.description: Turn on Do Not Disturb for the authenticated user for N minutes. Returns { snoozeEnabled, snoozeEndtime, snoozeRemaining }. Not retryable. Params: numMinutes (1-1440).

numMinutes.description: How long to snooze (in minutes). Min 1, max 1440 (24h).

tools.name: end-dnd
tools.description: End the current snooze. Returns { snoozeEnabled: false }. Idempotent. No params.

tools.name: get-dnd
tools.description: Get DND status for a user. Returns { snoozeEnabled, snoozeEndtime, snoozeRemaining, nextDndStart, nextDndEnd }. Retryable. Params: userId? (default: authed user).

userId.description: User id (U... / W...). Omit for the authenticated user.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-reactions
tools.description: Get reactions on a message or file. Provide EITHER (channel+timestamp) for a message OR (file) for a file. Returns { reactions: [{ name, count, users }], type, target }. Retryable. Params: channel?+timestamp? | file?, full (def true).

channel.description: Channel id (paired with timestamp for a message).

full.description: If true, all reactors are returned. Default true.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-team-preferences
tools.description: Get workspace policy preferences (locale, default channels, who can create/archive channels, message edit window, calls/huddles enabled). Returns curated preferences. Retryable. No params.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: create-list
tools.description: Create a Slack List (collaborative table). Returns curated list with schema. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: name, description?, schema? (JSON array of {name, type}), todoMode (def false).

tools.name: update-list
tools.description: Update list metadata or schema. Partial. Returns curated list. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, name?, description?, schema?, todoMode?.

tools.name: delete-list
tools.description: Delete a Slack List (and all its items). Returns { listId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId.

tools.name: get-list
tools.description: Get list details + schema. Returns curated list. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: list-list-items
tools.description: List items in a Slack List with cursor pagination. Returns { listId, items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, limit (1-100, def 50), cursor?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: create-list-item
tools.description: Add a row to a Slack List. fields is a JSON object mapping column-id → value. Returns curated item. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, fields (JSON).

fields.description: JSON object mapping column id to value.

tools.name: update-list-item
tools.description: Update fields of a list item. Partial update. Returns curated item. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, itemId, fields (JSON).

tools.name: delete-list-item
tools.description: Delete a list item. Returns { listId, itemId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: listId, itemId.

tools.name: create-canvas
tools.description: Create a standalone Slack Canvas (rich-text doc). Returns curated canvas. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: title, contentMarkdown? (initial content).

tools.name: edit-canvas
tools.description: Edit a canvas with a list of changes. changes is a JSON array of operations: [{operation:insert|replace|delete, sectionId?, document_content?:{type:markdown,markdown}}]. Returns curated canvas. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

tools.name: delete-canvas
tools.description: Delete a canvas. Returns { canvasId, deleted: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: canvasId.

tools.name: create-channel-canvas
tools.description: Create a canvas attached to a channel (visible to all members). Returns curated canvas. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: channelId, title?, contentMarkdown?.

tools.name: start-stream
tools.description: Start a streaming message (AI responses delivered chunk-by-chunk live). Returns { streamId, channel }. Use append-stream + stop-stream to complete. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: channel, threadTs?, recipientTeamId?.

channel.description: Channel id.

tools.name: append-stream
tools.description: Append a chunk of content to an active streaming message. Returns { streamId, appended: true, length }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: streamId, content.

tools.name: stop-stream
tools.description: Stop a streaming message (flushes final state). Returns { streamId, stopped: true }. Idempotent. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: streamId.

tools.name: add-call
tools.description: Register a call (external provider) with Slack. Returns curated call. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: externalUniqueId, joinUrl, desktopAppJoinUrl?, externalDisplayId?, title?, users? (JSON array), dateStart? (unix seconds).

externalUniqueId.description: Unique id for the call in the external provider.

dateStart.description: Unix seconds when the call started.

tools.name: end-call
tools.description: Mark a call as ended. Returns { callId, ended: true }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId, duration? (seconds).

tools.name: update-call
tools.description: Update call metadata (title or join URLs). Returns curated call. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId, title?, joinUrl?, desktopAppJoinUrl?.

tools.name: get-call
tools.description: Get call details (participants, duration, status). Returns curated call. Retryable. EXPERIMENTAL. Params: callId.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: add-call-participants
tools.description: Add participants to an active call. users is a JSON array of {slackId|externalId, displayName?, avatarUrl?}. Returns { callId, added: count }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

tools.name: remove-call-participants
tools.description: Remove participants from a call. users is a JSON array of {slackId|externalId}. Returns { callId, removed: count }. Not retryable. EXPERIMENTAL.

users.description: JSON array of participants to remove.

tools.name: rename-channel
tools.description: Rename a channel. Name ≤80 chars, lowercase, no spaces/periods (Slack normalizes). Returns curated channel. Not retryable. Params: channelId, name.

tools.name: set-channel-purpose
tools.description: Set the purpose of a channel (long-form description). Max 250 chars. Returns { channelId, purpose }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, purpose.

tools.name: set-channel-topic
tools.description: Set the topic of a channel (short description in header). Max 250 chars. Returns { channelId, topic }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, topic.

tools.name: kick-from-channel
tools.description: Remove a user from a channel. Requires admin or channel owner permissions. Returns { channelId, userId, kicked: true }. Not retryable. Params: channelId, userId.

tools.name: unarchive-channel
tools.description: Unarchive a previously archived channel. Returns curated channel. Not retryable. Params: channelId.

tools.name: mark-channel-read
tools.description: Mark all messages in a channel up to and including timestamp as read. Returns { channelId, timestamp, marked: true }. Idempotent. Params: channelId, timestamp.

timestamp.description: Message ts as the read cursor.

tools.name: get-upload-url
tools.description: Step 1 of modern multi-step upload: get pre-signed external URL. PUT bytes then call complete-upload. Returns { uploadUrl, fileId, filename, length }. Params: filename, length (bytes), altTxt?, snippetType?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: complete-upload
tools.description: Step 2 of modern upload: finalize after PUT-ing bytes. files=[{id, title?}]. Optionally share to channel/thread. Returns curated file(s). Not retryable. Params: files (JSON array), channelId?, initialComment?, threadTs?.

tools.name: share-file-public
tools.description: Make a file publicly accessible via URL. Returns { fileId, permalinkPublic }. Not retryable. Params: fileId.

tools.name: revoke-file-public
tools.description: Revoke a file's public URL. Returns { fileId, revoked: true }. Not retryable. Params: fileId.

tools.name: list-remote-files
tools.description: List remote files (external storage like Google Drive). Returns { files, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: channel?, tsFrom?, tsTo?, limit (1-200, def 100), cursor?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: add-remote-file
tools.description: Register an external file (Google Drive, Dropbox) with Slack. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable. Params: externalId, externalUrl, title, fileType?, previewImage?, indexableFileContents?.

tools.name: update-remote-file
tools.description: Update metadata of a remote file. Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable.

tools.name: remove-remote-file
tools.description: Remove a remote file reference (does not delete in external provider). Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns { removed: true }. Not retryable.

tools.name: share-remote-file
tools.description: Share a remote file to channels. Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Not retryable. Params: channels (csv), externalId? | fileId?.

tools.name: get-remote-file
tools.description: Get details of a remote file. Provide externalId XOR fileId. Returns curated remote file. Retryable.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: send-me-message
tools.description: Send a /me action message (third-person italic). Returns { ts, channel }. Not retryable. Params: channel, text.

channel.description: Channel id.

tools.name: unfurl-link
tools.description: Custom unfurl for links in a message. unfurls is JSON map url→{blocks, text}. Returns { channel, ts, unfurled: true, links }. Not retryable.

tools.name: list-user-channels
tools.description: List channels a user is a member of. Returns { channels, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: userId? (def authed), types? (csv), excludeArchived (def true), limit (1-1000, def 200), cursor?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: delete-user-photo
tools.description: Delete the authenticated user's profile photo. Returns { deleted: true }. Not retryable. No params.

tools.name: get-user-identity
tools.description: Get authenticated user's identity from OAuth (scope identity.basic). Returns curated identity. Retryable. No params.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: list-my-reactions
tools.description: List all items the user has reacted to. Returns { items, paging }. Retryable. Params: userId? (def authed), count (1-1000, def 100), page, full (def true).

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-team-dnd
tools.description: Get DND status for multiple users at once. Returns { users: [{ userId, snoozeEnabled, snoozeEndtime, nextDndStart, nextDndEnd }] }. Retryable. Params: users (csv of user ids).

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: star-item
tools.description: Save (star) a message / file / file comment. Provide exactly one of (channel+timestamp), file, fileComment. Returns { type, target, starred: true }. Idempotent.

tools.name: unstar-item
tools.description: Remove saved item. Same exclusive-choice contract as star-item. Returns { type, target, unstarred: true }. Idempotent.

tools.name: list-stars
tools.description: List the user's saved items. Returns { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Retryable. Params: count (1-1000, def 100), cursor?.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: list-emoji
tools.description: List custom workspace emojis. Returns { emojis: [{ name, url, isAlias, aliasFor }], count }. Retryable.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: add-emoji
tools.description: Add a custom workspace emoji. Provide EITHER url OR aliasFor. Returns { name, isAlias, aliasFor?, ok: true }. Workspace admin only. Not retryable.

tools.name: remove-emoji
tools.description: Remove a custom workspace emoji. Workspace admin only. Returns { name, removed: true }. Not retryable.

tools.name: get-access-logs
tools.description: Workspace login audit trail (paid plans). Returns { logs, paging }. Retryable. Params: before? (unix), count (1-1000, def 100), page.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-integration-logs
tools.description: Integration audit trail (apps installed/scope changes). Paid plans. Returns { logs, paging }. Retryable.

includeRaw.description: Return raw API response. Default false.

tools.name: get-team-profile
